**Finding resubmitted: compliant** (RENEWAL, §§ 8.2–8.3) — no redline, paragraphs unchanged.

The verifier's failed check was a false negative: the notice window is spelled in words, not digits. I re-read p0033/p0034 to confirm the text is unchanged and restated the parameters numerically in the rationale:

| Parameter | Document | Preferred | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-renewal notice window | thirty days = **30 days** | ≤ 30 | Meets preferred |
| Renewal term | successive twelve-month = **12 months** | 12 months | Meets preferred |
| Vendor reminder | sixty days = **60 days** before renewal, tolled to 30 days after receipt if missed | 60 | Meets preferred |
| Uplift cap | lesser of trailing 12-month CPI-U and three percent = **3%**, 90 days' notice, none on prepaid periods | lesser of CPI and 3% | Meets preferred |

Unchanged from my first pass: the Customer-only non-renewal right is an asymmetry in our favour and is not flagged, and § 2.1's three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" remains noted for the deal team as a minimum-commitment / termination-rights issue under a different rule — it may blunt the practical value of the opt-out, but it is not a defect in the renewal mechanics themselves.
